subject: Discovery recap & quick prioritization check — NorthStar Analytics
body:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@northstaranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Oct 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & quick prioritization check — NorthStar Analytics

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and two small asks so we can align next steps.

What we heard you want to validate (from today):
- Evaluate inference economics for your customer-facing recommendations pipeline (target: 99th pctile latency ~150ms, cost reduction vs current infra).
- Confirm behaviour preservation when quantizing the model for 8-bit / int8 flow.
- Pilot scope: 10k monthly active sessions, spike handling to ~150 rps.

Deliverables I promised:
- Short discovery notes (attached) summarizing call context and constraints.
- A draft SOW template with optional pilot configurations (attached).
- A follow-up plan: a 30-minute technical kickoff with your SRE and our Platform Eng to walk the pilot runbook.

Two asks (quick):
1) Can you confirm where this sits on your priority list right now? (high/medium/low) — that will help me decide whether to set up a pilot or send a lighter eval pack.
2) If high/medium: are you available for a 30-min tech kickoff next week (Oct 13–15)? If not, give me a week that works and I’ll loop in Marissa (technical lead).

Attachments: 20251005-discovery-notes.pdf (summary, 2 pages); SOW-template-v1.docx (pilot + optional scale clauses).

Thanks — I’ll hold a few windows next week but happy to flex to your timeline.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Just bumping this in case it got lost in a busy inbox. Any sense on priority/timing? Even a one-word reply (high/medium/low) is hugely helpful.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 11:22:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & quick prioritization check — NorthStar Analytics

Elena —
Wanted to follow up one more time before I pause outreach for a bit. I know Q4 planning ramps up and calendars fill fast. A couple of options so you can pick what’s easiest: 

A) Quick pilot kickoff (30 min) this month — we’ll confirm metrics, sampling plan, and a minimal SLI set.
B) I send a lightweight eval pack (short test harness + cost estimate) you can run with your infra team asynchronously.
C) If timing has slipped, tell me when you want me to re-open (e.g., "check back in November week of 3rd").

If procurement should be involved now, cc'ing procurement@northstaranalytics.com would be great — I can also prep a narrower SOW with optional terms. HubSpot note attached here for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/NS-2025-042

If I don’t hear back, I’ll check back in early November — unless you prefer a different cadence.

Best,
Vivek

---

From: Elena Park <elena@northstaranalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@northstaranalytics.com
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & quick prioritization check — NorthStar Analytics

Hi Vivek — apologies for the delayed reply; we’ve been heads-down on our Q4 roadmap and approvals.

Short answer: we’re interested, but priority has shifted slightly. Can you pause active scheduling for now? We expect to re-prioritize this in early November after a budget review.

Two things that would help us while we pause: 
- Send an updated SOW with optional pilot timelines (we’d like to see a 4-week and 8-week option).
- Can you include a high-level risk & compliance checklist specific to inference deployments (data residency + audit logs)? That will help our security reviewer.

If you send those docs I’ll circulate them to procurement and the platform team; I’ll aim to get a follow-up meeting on the calendar for the week of Nov 3.

Thanks — and no rush; appreciate you checking in.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Data Platforms | NorthStar Analytics
elena@northstaranalytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0987
